lastCompletedStory.title: Truncate long story titles in the Stories list rows

nextStoryContext: US-001 added an exported pure helper `truncateTitle(title, maxWidth)` and a fixed `STORY_TITLE_MAX_WIDTH = 40` constant in src/ui/Dashboard.tsx, applied to the title segment in both StoryRow variants (selected accent-bg row + unselected flex row). The detail subview (StoryDetailView, line ~314) is untouched by design (full title stays readable there). US-002 (Loop-header ghost hardening) targets src/commands/dashboard.ts only (runDashboardInk / the resize handler / CURSOR usage) and is unrelated to Dashboard.tsx, so no file overlap is expected; its own file-assert oracle says 'adds only src/commands/dashboard.ts beyond US-001's file', confirming Dashboard.tsx is expected to already show up as changed in the story-scoped diff. The file-size-budget.json ceiling for src/ui/Dashboard.tsx was raised 625->646 with tracker ref #66 staged in the same commit (US-001 pushed it just over budget); if US-002 also grows a tracked file, follow the same raise-and-retry procedure documented in patterns.md.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Ink 7's Text wrap="truncate-end" operates on the WHOLE text content of a single Text node (container-width based, no partial-segment truncation), which validates the story's Option (b) decision to use a standalone pure truncateTitle(title, maxWidth) helper applied only to the title segment, instead of Ink's built-in wrap prop, since the selected row concatenates icon+id+title+tokens into one Text node with backgroundColor and container-width truncation would have eaten the trailing tokens text.
